question.context: Revision-authored AQA-style practice question. UrbanTrail Cycles sells a commuter bicycle model.
question.stem:
UrbanTrail Cycles earns a contribution of £7.50 per commuter bicycle sold. In June, it sold 18,400 bicycles.

Calculate the total contribution made from sales of commuter bicycles in June. Show your working.

points.descriptor: Uses the total contribution method: contribution per unit × units sold.
accept: Contribution per unit multiplied by units sold

mark_scheme.model_answer:
Total contribution = contribution per unit × units sold
= £7.50 × 18,400
= £138,000

calcs.label: Total contribution from commuter bicycle sales
